quotes.text: ¿Qué es ... del jefe(a) de este hogar?
¿Actualmente... 1 vive con su pareja en unión libre? 2 está separado(a)? 3 está divorciado(a)? 4 está viudo(a)? 5 está casado(a)? 6 está soltero(a)?
(Solo para mujeres) ¿En total cuántas hijas e hijos que nacieron vivos ha tenido?
¿Cuánto ganó o en cuánto calcula sus ingresos?
¿Todas estas personas comparten el mismo gasto para comer?

assessments.reasoning: The survey allows distinguishing de jure versus de facto female-headed households because Section VI collects relationship to head (P7), sex (P8), and marital status (P19), which together show whether a female head is unpartnered (single, separated, divorced, widowed) or has a partner who is absent from the household roster. However, unpartnered mother-child units inside larger extended households cannot be identified because P7 only records relationship to the household head rather than inter-member parent-child linkages, and P18 only counts total children ever born alive per woman. Furthermore, the questionnaire does not identify a 'main provider' at the household or unit level to establish women-maintained status independently of the designated household head. Finally, mother-child units cannot be linked to their own hearth-hold consumption or production activities, as food expenditure (P2) is only used to define household boundaries as a whole.
